about: The mutation batches `bun nv select --mutate tools/data/select-mutations.json` applies one batch at a time. Every edit breaks something a test, case, proof program or check sees; every atom that goes red must have been selected. No two edits of a batch touch one file.

batches.note: a fn body in a stdlib class file: a leading dot reads as an extension, so `Core\Path::extension('.gitignore')` is 'gitignore' (nvs-stdlib path tests)
a const in a runtime table: the 0.05 latency bucket becomes 0.04 (nvs-server prometheus scrape test)
a docs/reference/core intro, build-script input for the help and hover text (tests/lsp hover case on a core class card)
profile-only code: the optimized build's pooled realloc copies only 16 bytes when a block changes class (proof programs judged on target/proof)
a registry row of one class: `Core\Math::max` calls min (Core\Math max examples)
a macro_rules! body: decimal subtraction, division and remainder swap their operands (tests/conformance/core decimal cases)
a data file a test reads: the fixture no longer reports E0110 (nvs-cli tests/check.rs)
a tools module a `bun nv` check uses: no feature finds its about.md, so every group owes a description (`bun nv proofs --verify --group` checks, tools tests)
an include_str! target: the shipped template gets a live key (nvs-config tests/directives.rs)
a class card: the list of classes that owe a card names `Core\IO`, which has one (nvs-stdlib registry card test)

batches.replace:
// This program does not compile.
var $x = (;
batches.note: a new .nvs file in a directory a check lists: an example that does not compile and has no .out (`bun nv proofs --verify --group "Core\Reflect\ClassInfo"`)
nvs.toml: scripts may no longer spawn a child (concurrency examples and proofs that start a job)

batches.find: autoload 'App' from './src';                       // one prefix, one root
batches.replace: autoload 'App' from 'src';                         // one prefix, one root
batches.note: an include_str! target in shipped code: the chapter `nvs agent show` prints a section from loses the `./` (nvs-cli tests/agent.rs keyword section test)

batches.find: short: "The result of a program that has ended. `Core\\Process::run` and \
batches.replace: short: "The result of a program that has finished. `Core\\Process::run` and \
batches.note: a class card's prose: `Core\Process\Result`'s card, which `nvs agent show` prints, says finished (nvs-cli tests/agent.rs class card prose test)
an enum discriminant in a runtime type: `Tag::Bytes` moves into a hole, so it no longer agrees with the parameter nibble compiled code checks (nvs-codegen tag nibble test, callables over `bytes`)
